summary: Replace per-surface hand-written fleetContext prompt sections with a compact, typed context service that returns only task-relevant facts, each with source, timestamp, confidence, and expiry; automatically prune stale session detail and raw audio references.
note: KEPT OPEN deliberately: this entry is specifically the cloud-relay/fleetContext.js migration, which is genuinely NOT done — the relay still hand-writes its per-surface prompt sections. The local half already shipped as chg-96771ece + chg-6360d815 (implemented): local-agent/memoryService.js stores typed facts with provenance, confidence, sensitivity, expiry and lastUsed; local-agent/contextProjection.js does the task-scoped projection; measured 3,400 facts -> 198 tokens. Migration plan: local-agent/bridge.js calls GET /memory/projection and puts the returned text into fleet.memory, replacing the hand-written fleetContext sections. cloud-relay/ is owned elsewhere and was not edited.
